SELECT @{activity('Script Columns Candelaria AD').output.resultSets[0].rows[0].Result} FROM @{item().SchemaSourceName}.@{item().TableSourceName} 
WHERE @{if(equals(item().WaterMarkVal, null), concat(item().SourceFilter), concat(item().IncrementalColumn, ' > ''', item().WatermarkVal, ''''))}

text.value:
DECLARE @columns VARCHAR(MAX) 
SELECT @columns = COALESCE(@columns + ', ', '') + ('[' + column_name + ']' + ' AS ' + '[' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(column_name, '-', '_'))), '(', '_'), ')', ''), ' ', '_') + ']')
FROM   INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE  column_name LIKE '%'
      AND TABLE_NAME = @{concat('''', item().TableSourceName, '''')}  
	AND TABLE_SCHEMA = @{concat('''', item().SchemaSourceName, '''')};

SELECT (@columns) AS Result
